intake.business_request_raw: End-to-end translator validation — morning payload + caching + DTO auto-populate + doctor H11.
assumptions: The 'doctor H11' module is a critical component requiring specific validation.
Existing caching mechanisms are insufficient and require enhancement.
Morning payloads are a significant part of daily operations.

domain_invariants.statement: Define explicit error handling and observability requirements.
Map acceptance criteria to executable test types.

scenarios.name: Process morning payload
gherkin: Given a payload received at 8 AM
When the system processes the payload
Then it should be completed within 5 minutes
And the status should be logged

scenarios.name: Retrieve data from cache
gherkin: When a request for cached data is made
Then the data should be retrieved within 2 seconds
And cache statistics should be updated

scenarios.name: Populate DTO from payload
gherkin: Given a payload with valid data
Then the DTO should contain all data accurately
And errors should be logged if any

scenarios.name: Validate doctor H11 processing
gherkin: Given input parameters for doctor H11
When the module processes the input
Then the output should match expected results
And all operations should be logged

risks.description: Potential data loss during DTO auto-population.
risks.mitigation: Implement thorough testing and validation of DTOs.

risks.description: Caching mechanism may introduce stale data issues.
risks.mitigation: Implement cache invalidation strategies and monitoring.

must.title: Security and Compliance
must.description: Ensure the system meets security and compliance requirements.
must.metric: System passes all security audits and compliance checks.
acceptance_criteria: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
Access controls are enforced and logged.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: Ensure the system is reliable and available.
must.metric: System uptime is 99.9% over a rolling 30-day period.
acceptance_criteria: System uptime is monitored and reported monthly.
Redundancy is implemented for critical components.

should.title: Performance Optimization
should.description: Ensure the system performs efficiently under load.
should.metric: System processes 95% of payloads within 5 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests show 95% of payloads are processed within 5 minutes.
System can handle peak load with no degradation in performance.
Response times are logged and analyzed for continuous improvement.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

should.title: Usability
should.description: Ensure the system is user-friendly and easy to navigate.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 4.5/5 in usability surveys.
acceptance_criteria: Usability tests are conducted with end-users bi-annually.
Feedback is collected and analyzed for improvements.
Documentation is updated and accessible to users.
